video.subject_count.evidence: [director·claude] I counted each of the 32 frames on sheet 1 (0.000–7.750 s). Every frame shows exactly one person, Asellina, behind the counter. Nobody else appears or disappears, and there is no duplicate of her. This matches the spec: a single-person medium close-up with Riley off screen.

video.no_text.evidence: [director·claude·审稿兜底，待机检工具] Apart from the yellow timecode the QC tool adds to each frame's top-left corner, none of the 32 frames shows subtitles, a watermark, a logo or UI. The back wall has only the duck and rooster murals and no lettering.

video.object_continuity.evidence: [director·claude] I tracked each item through all 32 frames. The round wooden lid with a handle (left foreground), the open clay jar mouth (bottom right), the marble-chip countertop, and the hanging items and window in the upper left all stay in the same place from 0.000 to 7.750 s. Nothing appears from nowhere, vanishes, floats or passes through anything. Her left hand rests on the counter edge the whole time. Her right hand goes from one finger to two at 2.750 s and stays at two fingers from 2.750 to 7.750 s without dropping back. Caveat: the sheet is small, so I can't confirm frame by frame that the finger count never wavers (for example a third finger or a blurred hand). Nothing obvious is wrong.

video.person_still.evidence: [director·claude·审稿兜底，待机检工具] Without the motion tool I judged from the sheet. Frames 0.000–2.500 s (cells 1–11) are nearly identical: one finger raised, closed-mouth smile, head and body motionless. That still stretch is about 2.5 s, over the 1.5 s limit, and the storyboard does not call for a quiet hold here. The spec has her raise her eyebrows and add the second finger at 0.3–1.2 s, so she should be moving. Frames 3.000–4.500 s (V sign, mouth closed, almost no change) are another still stretch of about 1.5 s or more, and per the spec she should already be speaking the line (1.6–5.3 s). She looks like a statue here.

video.acting_natural.evidence: [作者复审·现行规则] 2.5–2.75 秒一根变两根，3.0–4.25 秒挑眉笑着竖两根等她（得意停顿），4.3–7.72 秒说完整句，6.5–6.75 秒朝前景木盖陶罐扬下巴；开头 0.38–1.88 秒定格在剪辑里掐掉（入点 1.9 秒）。

video.point_landed.evidence: [作者复审·现行规则] 两根手指 2.75 秒起清楚一直竖到 8.0 秒，配 Dupondium si dederis, meliora bibes（4.3–7.72 秒）；朝酒罐扬下巴 6.5–6.75 秒偏短，记录。
